data.name: Gayana
data.gender_notes: Gayana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who chants or recites the sacred texts. Derived from the Sanskrit root 'gam' meaning 'to go' and 'vidh' meaning 'to know'. The name Gayana carries the meaning “Song, Melody” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gayana usually hope their child will grow to embody song, melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with knowledge, wisdom, and the power of the sacred word.
data.etymology: Gayana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Song, Melody.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gayana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
